title: The last Sunday, on a phone
logline: Tourist Season: a tourist on the seawall bench holding a phone, and on it the last public Sunday — the 1997 cafeteria redrawn, the droplet, the figure into fog — scrolled to its last tier. The page reads it over her shoulder and doesn't say whose it is.

panels.composition: Over a tourist's shoulder on the seawall bench: her phone, and on it a watercolor Sunday's last tier — a figure walking into fog with 'thank you for reading' too small to read — the real bay gray beyond the screen.

characters.pose: on the bench with a phone

props: the last Sunday on a phone

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, over a seated tourist's shoulder on a seawall bench, a phone screen showing the last tier of a watercolor comic page with a small figure walking into fog, the real gray bay beyond, no words legible
image.notes: dw_2020-12-27's last tier on a screen. Twenty months on.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The last Sunday, read on the seawall by a stranger.
